The '''Power Center Imperial Transport''' was the name given to one of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] transporters located in the [[Power Center cavern]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It was so named because the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] took control of it during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Empire.<ref name="LOC" />
